title: Fagani language
description: Austronesian language spoken in the Solomon Islands
extract: The Fagani or Faghani language is a member of the family of San Cristobal languages, and is spoken in the northwest part of the island of Makira, formerly known as San Cristobal, in the Solomon Islands.
